p.src: 2  “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

en: “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.
u.src: 2  “Even today my complaint is rebellious. His hand is heavy in spite of my groaning.

p.src: 3  Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

en: Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!
u.src: 3  Oh that I knew where I might find him! That I might come even to his seat!

p.src: 4  I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

en: I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.
u.src: 4  I would set my cause in order before him, and fill my mouth with arguments.

p.src: 5  I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

en: I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.
u.src: 5  I would know the words which he would answer me, and understand what he would tell me.

p.src: 6  Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

en: Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.
u.src: 6  Would he contend with me in the greatness of his power? No, but he would listen to me.

p.src: 7  There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

en: There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.
u.src: 7  There the upright might reason with him, so I should be delivered forever from my judge.

p.src: 8  “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

en: “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.
u.src: 8  “If I go east, he is not there. If I go west, I can’t find him.

p.src: 9  He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

en: He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.
u.src: 9  He works to the north, but I can’t see him. He turns south, but I can’t catch a glimpse of him.

p.src: 10  But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

en: But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.
u.src: 10  But he knows the way that I take. When he has tried me, I will come out like gold.

p.src: 11  My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

en: My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.
u.src: 11  My foot has held fast to his steps. I have kept his way, and not turned away.

p.src: 12  I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

en: I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.
u.src: 12  I haven’t gone back from the commandment of his lips. I have treasured up the words of his mouth more than my necessary food.

p.src: 13  But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

en: But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.
u.src: 13  But he stands alone, and who can oppose him? What his soul desires, even that he does.

p.src: 14  For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

en: For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.
u.src: 14  For he performs that which is appointed for me. Many such things are with him.

p.src: 15  Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

en: Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.
u.src: 15  Therefore I am terrified at his presence. When I consider, I am afraid of him.

p.src: 16  For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

en: For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.
u.src: 16  For God has made my heart faint. The Almighty has terrified me.

p.src: 17  Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.

en: Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
u.src: 17  Because I was not cut off before the darkness, neither did he cover the thick darkness from my face.
